get_current_time: get the current time as a formatted string from the MCP tools module
get_current_time_short: get the current time in short format (e.g., "10:30 AM") from the MCP tools module
get_current_date: get the current date as a formatted string from the MCP tools module
get_current_date_short: get the current date in short format (e.g., "Oct 15") from the MCP tools module
run_mcp_tools: run the MCP tools module to retrieve current time and date values
